roles.5.6 Terra: Primary narrative and production review: causal chain, character intent, emotional beat, shot objective, and prompt clarity.
roles.Grok 4.6: Optional adversarial review only: identify implausible motives, stale premises, viewer confusion, cliches, and missing causal bridges.
roles.5.6 Sol: Arbitrates only material disagreement between the primary and red-team reviews; it does not replace deterministic safety or asset gates.
roles.5.6 Luna: Formats approved packets and reports; it may not approve, reject, submit provider work, or publish assets.

grok_activation: Requires fresh scoped provider health evidence. If absent, omit the red-team pass and mark the report CONDITIONAL rather than fabricate a review.

verdicts.READY: All deterministic gates pass and any required reviewer verdict is supportive.
verdicts.CONDITIONAL: Hard gates pass but an optional reviewer, health receipt, or visual trial remains pending. One bounded test shot may proceed.
verdicts.REWORK: Narrative, continuity, asset assignment, or shot-state problem must be repaired before provider submission.
verdicts.BLOCKED: Missing asset/URL, unsupported renderer feature, unsafe scope, or invalid contract prevents submission.

non_authority: No reviewer may publish a video.
No reviewer may override an invalid asset hash, inaccessible URL, or production_integration=true.
No reviewer output proves a completed provider call or visual quality.
